data.description:
## Incident Overview

tests/docs/test-commit-workflow-validation-canonical-list.sh greps documentation content for literal hook names (`check-portability.sh`, `pre-commit-test-gate.sh`, etc.) and section headings. Pattern is brittle to legitimate docs reformatting (heading rename, list-format change).

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [11] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; analysis classified MINOR — pattern is intentional contract-anchor enforcement (catches agent doc-rewrite divergence). Recorded for review of whether structural enforcement (e.g., heading-tree parsing) is preferable.

## Suggested Fix

Either (a) accept the pattern with a header comment documenting why grep is the correct tool here, or (b) replace with structural matchers that tolerate cosmetic edits.
